threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the Tube is reliable—bless your heart! It’s not just delays, it’s a lifestyle choice out here.
Caught a glimpse of two guys arguing about the best kebab shop on Night Bus 77. One swore by the one near Balham, while the other claimed it was all about the one on Clapham High Street.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was truly home when the street vendor remembered my order—beers for me and the same currywurst for my mate. Little things, you know?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a kebab shop that serves late-night currywurst topped with döner meat. It's a wild fusion, but somehow it works.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows to avoid Valencia during rush hour—those bike lanes become instant gridlock. Tourists just seem confused.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy in the Tenderloin juggling three oranges on the bus while discussing a side gig. Only in SF do Muni rides come with a side of entertainment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can conquer Gràcia in a day, but really, it takes weeks to find all the hidden plazas and local secrets tucked away from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell a newbie—they're the ones staring at the metro map like it's a cryptic treasure map, completely lost in L5.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep saying 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground'. Locals know you get everywhere here above ground.
Last night on the bus, a guy serenaded a couple with Morrissey lyrics while the driver just sighed. Brixton nightlife at its finest.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a group of kids turn an empty lot into a makeshift skate park with just a few crates and their creativity. That’s Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it's not unusual to see open-air yoga sessions in parks, often led by a man in a vintage tracksuit blasting techno. Only in Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can name at least three taco trucks on the same block without missing a beat.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy practicing his trumpet on the bus while his dog looked on like it was a concert. Only in SF do you get free entertainment with your ride.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just about Gaudí. They miss the hidden plazas where locals sip vermut and gossip. That's where the real vibe is.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You'll see them staring at the metro map like it’s an ancient scroll, especially near Fontana station. Locals just glide by.
